rule_meaning: At least 2 independent sources support the problem statement (established findings, or people describing it in their own verified words), and nothing contradicts it. This justifies experiments with customers; it is not proof of demand or of a market.

missing_evidence: Demand and willingness to pay (A6): Desk research cannot establish demand or willingness to pay; only experiments with target customers can.
Validation conditions: none set. Set pass marks before running any experiment.

experiments.name: Pricing survey
experiments.method: Ask 10 screen reader users about willingness to pay for PDF conversion
experiments.support_if: At least 3 users say they would pay 5 EUR or more
experiments.weaken_if: All users say they would not pay more than 1 EUR

experiments.name: Problem interviews
experiments.method: Talk to people who match 'blind and low-vision people who use screen readers' about the last time they dealt with this problem. Ask what happened and what they did; do not pitch the idea.
experiments.support_if: Most interviewees describe a recent, specific occurrence without being prompted. Write down the pass mark before you start, as a validation condition in the brief.
experiments.weaken_if: Most cannot recall a recent occurrence, or say it is minor or already solved.

experiments.name: Honest interest test (Validate phase)
experiments.method: A plain page that describes the planned product as not yet built and invites people to join a waitlist. No payment, no countdowns, no testimonials.
experiments.support_if: Visitors from the target group join at a rate above the pass mark you set. Write down the pass mark before you start, as a validation condition in the brief.
experiments.weaken_if: Few visitors join, or those who join are not in the target group.

counterfactual.reconsidered_by: phase2 validation gate, against the founder's predefined validation conditions
counterfactual.no_guarantee: New evidence can strengthen or weaken the case. Running these experiments does not guarantee a GO decision, customers or income.
